observations: Single solar panel shown, leaning against an interior wall near a glass door.
Panel has a black frame and black monocrystalline-style cells (half-cut cell pattern visible).
A semi-transparent watermark reading 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' overlays the image; this is a watermark, not a label on the panel.
No manufacturer nameplate, spec sticker, wattage rating, or junction box clearly visible in the photo.
Only one angled, glare-affected view is provided; no close-up of cells or back of panel.
No multimeter, output test, or packaging shown.

claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text, not a factual claim about this specific panel's condition or specs.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating unknown, which is the primary price driver for a solar panel
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the manufacturer's spec sticker (usually on the back) showing Wp, Voc, Isc
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced even at worst case without a plausible wattage range; treat as missing critical spec

risks.risk: Panel could be used/refurbished rather than new
risks.proof: Photo of original packaging/box or seller's explicit written claim with supporting shot

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (micro-cracks, hotspots, corrosion) not visible due to glare and single angle
risks.proof: Multiple straight-on photos in even light showing full cell surface, plus back of panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed defect-free, i.e. at a discount for unverifiable condition

risks.risk: Panel may not produce rated output (dead cells, bypass diode failure)
risks.proof: Video or photo of multimeter reading open-circuit voltage under sunlight

risks.risk: Manufacturer/brand unknown, affecting warranty and resale value
risks.proof: Close-up of nameplate/sticker showing brand and model number

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rear spec label showing wattage (Wp), Voc, Isc, and manufacturer/model.
Straight-on, well-lit photos of the full front and back of the panel to check for cracks or damage.
A video or photo of a multimeter reading the panel's open-circuit voltage in sunlight.
Confirmation and photo evidence of new vs used status (box, invoice, or visible wear).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a generic solar panel, but without a visible wattage rating or spec label the price range is too wide to set even a worst-case figure; the wattage label is the missing shot that unlocks pricing.
